routers.title: Social
routers.description: Public posts, profiles, and video transcripts from social networks. Use it to read a post from its URL.

tools.name: v1_get_post
tools.title: Get post
tools.description: Get one public post by URL, with its author, text, media, and engagement counts. For the spoken text of a video post, call v1_get_post_transcript.

tools.name: v1_get_post_transcript
tools.title: Get post transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a video post by URL. Returns the transcript text, or an empty string when the post has no speech.

tools.name: v2beta.get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Get a public profile by handle, with its display name, bio, and follower count. Use v1_get_post for a single post.

handle.description: Account handle without the @, such as 'example'.
